title: Age of Mythology: Retold – Update 19.12998
description: Welcome heroes to another exciting update for Age of Mythology: Retold, featuring a wide range of gameplay improvements, balance adjustments across multiple civilizations, and continued refinements to stability and performance. This patch also brings updates to visuals, audio, UI, and hotkeys, along with quality-of-life fixes, campaign improvements, and ongoing support for modding and tools. As always, take a moment to explore the full notes before jumping back into the game and experiencing the latest changes firsthand!
